errors.trigger: A JSON locator is unreadable or invalid.
A public or private object violates its closed contract.
errors.remediation: Rebuild the object from current package schemas.

errors.trigger: Task, Git, GitHub, review, plan, or transaction identity changed.
errors.remediation: Rerun Delivery Review or reprepare the publication transaction.

errors.trigger: Delivery PR body contains an Issue closing keyword.
errors.remediation: Use Refs only; Completion owns later closure decisions.

errors.trigger: A bound Git or GitHub mutation did not reach its exact postcondition.
errors.remediation: Resume the same transaction after the external blocker clears.
Inspect package runtime without repeating remote mutations.
